summary: Regression test after the code-review refactor (fattura_parser split into helpers, ResultsPanel extraction, stable keys, env-based test credentials). Backend: the existing suites test_multitenant.py and test_users_auth.py ran serially with credentials read from env: 41 passed, 2 skipped. The new test_parser_regression.py passed 10/10. It covers sample XML field mapping (numero/data/anno/totali/righe/riepilogo/pagamenti/cedente/cessionario/trasmissione), multi-body XML, BOM, Nome+Cognome, the totale fallback when ImportoTotaleDocumento is missing, multiple Causale, errors (invalid XML, non-FatturaElettronica, missing header/body/numero), p7m decode and bad p7m, nested zip inside zip, skipping __MACOSX and hidden files, bad zip, unsupported format, and end-to-end upload with persistence and duplicate detection. Frontend (Playwright, desktop): the upload results panel shows counts (3 ok / 2 duplicate / 2 errors) and per-file rows with tipo badge, numero, message and 3 'Apri' links. Folder upload with a real directory and subfolder works ('2 file supportati su 3 trovati', .txt filtered out). The invoice detail page renders cedente, cessionario, causale, righe, riepilogo IVA, pagamento and totale correctly. The XML toggle shows the raw XML and switches back. Isolation: test_single sees only its own P.IVA (static sidebar), and a request with another P.IVA header returns 403. Auth basics: bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookies set, CORS uses an explicit origin with credentials. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: InvoiceDetail Summary key `iva-${aliquota}-${natura}` can collide when a FatturaPA has two DatiRiepilogo blocks with the same aliquota and natura (for example the same Natura N2.2 with a different RiferimentoNormativo, or different EsigibilitaIVA). This would only cause a React duplicate-key warning. Consider adding the index or riferimento_normativo to the key.
Righe key falls back to the index only when numero_linea is empty. Duplicate NumeroLinea values (seen in some non-compliant generators) would collide. Low risk.
The refactored parser behaves exactly like before for every case tested; the type hints are fine.
seed_data_creation: Used seed_multivat_ui.py seed for UI tests, plus temporary company 01234567890 in test_parser_regression (removed by its fixture). Everything was cleaned up afterwards; the DB holds only the admin (0 companies/invoices/anagrafiche).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest backend/tests/test_multitenant.py backend/tests/test_users_auth.py backend/tests/test_parser_regression.py -n 0`. Note that test_parser_regression and test_multitenant both use VAT 01234567890, so do not run them in parallel. For Playwright set_input_files, use only buffers (you cannot mix paths and buffers). For the webkitdirectory input, pass a real directory path. Admin password was not changed and forgot-password was not triggered.
